necessary_context.content: Continuously differentiable convex f:R^n→R; unconstrained minimization. e_i is the coordinate unit vector; the paper also uses ∇_i f for the singleton vector ∂_i f e_i. x* denotes a minimizer.
necessary_context.name: Objective and coordinate notation

necessary_context.content: For all x,y, f(y)≥f(x)+<∇f(x),y−x>+(sigma/2)||y−x||_2^2. Coordinate smoothness: for all x, delta>0 and i, |∂_i f(x+delta e_i)−∂_i f(x)|≤L_i delta. Select beta=0, sigma_0=sigma, alpha=1/2 and S=sum_i sqrt(L_i). Algorithm divisions require positive L_i and sigma.
necessary_context.name: Selected Euclidean assumptions
